mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_survey_answer ( answer_id, response_id, question_id, option_id, answer_text, answer_number, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{answerId}, #{responseId}, #{questionId}, #{optionId}, #{answerText}, #{answerNumber}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, NOW(), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT a.answer_id, a.response_id, a.question_id, a.option_id, a.answer_text, a.answer_number, a.created_by, a.created_ip, a.created_at, a.updated_by, a.updated_ip, a.updated_at, q.question_text AS question_text, o.option_text AS option_text FROM tb_survey_answer a LEFT JOIN tb_survey_question q ON q.question_id = a.question_id LEFT JOIN tb_survey_option o ON o.option_id = a.option_id WHERE a.response_id = #{responseId} ORDER BY q.sort_order ASC
SELECT a.option_id AS optionId, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM tb_survey_answer a WHERE a.question_id = #{questionId} AND a.option_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY a.option_id

SELECT COUNT(answer_number) AS cnt, AVG(answer_number) AS avgVal, MIN(answer_number) AS minVal, MAX(answer_number) AS maxVal FROM tb_survey_answer WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND answer_number IS NOT NULL
